field_changes.old: A reimagined onboarding experience is here — smooth entrance animations, satisfying haptics, and all-new steps that make beginning your fitness journey feel more exciting than ever. Elite members will also notice a more polished Load Progression star and more accurate volume and rep totals in the exercise charts. Plus a handful of bug fixes and reliability improvements.
field_changes.new: Your Autoplay sessions just got more reliable — workout mode now locks in at the start so the app never accidentally switches you between Autoplay and Traditional mid-session, and an in-progress Autoplay workout picks right back up after a relaunch. Custom exercise images uploaded on the web now appear correctly during workouts and in post-workout sharing, and your warm-up sets stay intact when adaptive phases kick in. Plus a handful of bug fixes.
